name: The Conjuring
combined_text: A paranormal investigator couple helps a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse. Supernatural scares, demonic haunting, and sleepless nights.

name: A Quiet Place
combined_text: A family must live in silence while hiding from blind creatures that hunt by sound. Tense, terrifying survival with monsters lurking in the dark.

name: Hereditary
combined_text: After a family's matriarch dies, they uncover terrifying secrets and a sinister fate. Slow-burn dread, cults, and unspeakable grief.

name: Get Out
combined_text: A young man visits his girlfriend's family estate and discovers a disturbing conspiracy. Unsettling, chilling, and full of creeping menace.

name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
combined_text: Teenager Miles Morales becomes Spider-Man and teams up with heroes from other dimensions. Colorful animated superhero adventure full of action.

name: The Amazing Spider-Man
combined_text: Peter Parker gains spider powers and battles the Lizard across the city. A classic web-slinging superhero origin story.

name: Mad Max: Fury Road
combined_text: In a post-apocalyptic desert, a warrior and a rebel flee a tyrant in a relentless car chase. Explosive high-octane action and stunts.

name: John Wick
combined_text: A retired hitman seeks revenge against the gangsters who wronged him. Stylish gun-fu action, relentless fight scenes, and revenge.

name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
combined_text: A legendary concierge and his protege get entangled in the theft of a priceless painting. Quirky, whimsical comedy with elaborate capers.

name: Superbad
combined_text: Two high school friends scheme to throw a party before graduation. Raunchy, hilarious teen comedy about friendship.

name: Paddington 2
combined_text: A polite bear searches for the perfect gift and ends up wrongly imprisoned. Heartwarming family comedy full of gentle humor.

name: Interstellar
combined_text: Explorers travel through a wormhole near Saturn to find humanity a new home. Epic space science fiction about time, gravity, and love.

name: Blade Runner 2049
combined_text: A replicant blade runner uncovers a secret that could upend society. Moody, atmospheric science fiction set in a dystopian future.

name: The Martian
combined_text: An astronaut stranded on Mars must engineer his own survival until rescue. Smart, hopeful science fiction about problem solving in space.

name: Finding Nemo
combined_text: A timid clownfish crosses the ocean to rescue his captured son. Beautiful animated undersea adventure for the whole family.

name: The Lion King
combined_text: A young lion prince flees his kingdom after his father's death and must reclaim his throne. Animated musical about courage and destiny.

name: Toy Story
combined_text: A cowboy doll grows jealous when a spaceman toy becomes the new favorite. Groundbreaking animated adventure about toys that come to life.

name: Coco
combined_text: A boy journeys to the Land of the Dead to unlock his family's history and musical dreams. Vibrant animated family film about memory and music.
